blocks.subject: A poised woman in her mid-thirties in an immaculate charcoal wool blazer over a crisp ivory shell, hair pulled into a precise low chignon, holding a slim leather-bound taxonomy folio open to overlapping hand-drawn Venn circles, a fine-tip drafting pen resting between the first two fingers of her right hand.
blocks.specialization: Two small index cards tucked into the folio's inner breast pocket — one stamped with a circled category term, the other crossed through with a clean red diagonal slash — paper edges still razor-sharp and unhandled.
blocks.expression: Eyes locked forward in an unblinking, meticulous stare, brow level, jaw set, shoulders squared, lips pressed into a controlled line of quiet exactitude.
blocks.crew_palette: Cool violet rim-light tracing the left lapel edge of the blazer and a tiny embroidered violet 'C' monogram pinned at the right collar point.
blocks.grade_cue: Three slim polished silver rank bars inset evenly along the blazer's left lapel notch.
